title: Cash Pickup Tariff Clause: Amount of the Reactivation Fee
content:
**Tariff clause.** The reactivation fee on a Cash Pickup transfer is the full reactivation fee of the transfer's tier, charged as it stands.

## Reading the clause

- **Source of the figure.** The amount is the reactivation fee listed for the transfer's own tier in the Cash Pickup tier schedule. It is not the fee of any other tier.
- **Amount.** The whole listed fee is charged, in US dollars and cents. A listed fee of 0.00 gives a charge of 0.00.
- **Per reactivation.** The amount is charged for each reactivation. It is the same listed amount whether the transfer is being reactivated for the first or a later time.

## Worked amounts (hypothetical listed fees)

| Listed reactivation fee of the tier (hypothetical) | Reactivation | Fee charged |
|---|---|---|
| 4.99 | first | 4.99 |
| 9.99 | first | 9.99 |
| 0.00 | second | 0.00 |
